title: Pure Light and Darkness Ritual
summary: The Light and Darkness Ritual cards with Ragged Records of Rites, Black Skull Dragon and generic staples, built to play the page's combo lines. Both Ritual Monsters are unaffected by the opponent's activated effects unless targeted. Griffoh pays a whole Level 8 Ritual alone, and Light and Darkness Ritual returns itself and another card from the GY every turn. Mind Shuffle searches the monsters and tags them in and out on the opponent's turn. Spell Shattering Sword and Black Skull Dragon, the newest cards, came in Beyond the Brave: the Sword zeroes and negates a monster, and the Dragon Sets it from the Deck.

allow.Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Uni: Beyond the Brave support: discards a Quick-Play or Ritual Spell to summon itself and Sets a Spell/Trap that mentions Light and Darkness Ritual.

main: Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness
Ritual: banishes a card when summoned, can't be destroyed by battle, and attacks twice.
Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos
Ritual: returns a Spell from the GY, banishes a card face-down, and protects your Spells/Traps.
Black Chaos
Shuffles a Ritual Monster back to summon itself; discards to place Mind Shuffle; banishes two cards.
Skull Archfiend of Chaos
Summons itself by recycling three cards; sent to the GY, mills the Ritual Spell to search a Ritual Monster.
Celtic Mystic
Summoned: draws three and discards two; Tributes itself to summon a Ritual Monster from the hand.
Griffoh
Discards to Set a Quick-Play or Trap that names the Ritual, live this turn; pays a whole Level 8 Ritual alone.
Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Unity
Newest support. Discards a Quick-Play or Ritual Spell to summon itself and Sets a Light and Darkness Spell/Trap.
Light and Darkness Ritual
Ritual Spell for both bosses, tributing or banishing from the GY; returns itself and another card each turn.
Ragged Records of Rites
Generic: reveals Light and Darkness Ritual to search a monster that names it.
Spell Shattering Sword
Newest support. Destroys their face-up Spells, or zeroes and negates a monster.
Chaos Magical Hats
Quick-Play: turns their effect into destroying a face-down hat.
Chaos Mystic Box
Quick-Play: dodges a targeting effect, destroys a card, and swaps in another monster.
Mind Shuffle
Searches a monster that names the Ritual, and tags a Level 7+ out for another on their turn.
